The recipe below is a complete deterministic client loop. A scripted
client can execute it using this recipe, the separate public docs/llms.txt rules,
and operator-supplied inputs:
mcpUrl (origin, without /mcp), gatewayUrl (trusted origin), keystore (local),
contextFile (trusted local transfer context), recipient (hex public key), and a
local signer password. Login HTTP paths are relative to mcpUrl. Only public data,
prepared messages and signatures cross HTTP/MCP. The password stays local.

Recipe v1 notation: $name.path reads a saved result or inputs; local invokes the
reviewed reset-signer CLI, saves input JSON, and supplies --directory locally.
flags.state saves that snapshot as JSON; flags.context names the already trusted
file. http fetches JSON, connect starts Streamable HTTP with Bearer token, tool
calls an MCP tool, save names the result, check must hold, and wait repeats reads
until its predicate holds. Before signing a move, repeat preparation, review and
trusted-state reads until the packet’s block height/hash equal that snapshot.
The clock can advance between two HTTP reads; never weaken signer checks to
accept mismatched reads. These retries happen before signing or submission.
add/subtract compute integer-unit strings; eq compares
exactly, gte compares integers, all combines predicates, every/some evaluate array
members as $item. text means a tool result is plain text. An error stops the smoke
check; for interactive use refresh state and preparation before retrying a rejected
move, and inspect account changes before retrying an uncertain submission. A
successful submission is not finality. Re-login on token expiry. Never resubmit a
new transfer until an uncertain earlier transfer has been checked for settlement.

BEGIN CLIENT PLAN
{
  "v": 1,
  "steps": [
    {"local":{"command":"address"},"save":"identity"},
    {"http":{"base":"$inputs.mcpUrl","path":"/auth/challenge","body":{"address":"$identity.address"}},"save":"challenge"},
    {"local":{"command":"sign_challenge","input":"$challenge","flags":{"audience":"$inputs.mcpUrl"}},"save":"loginSignature"},
    {"http":{"base":"$inputs.mcpUrl","path":"/auth/login","body":"$loginSignature"},"save":"login"},
    {"connect":{"path":"/mcp","token":"$login.token"}},
    {"tool":"reset_rules","text":true,"save":"rules"},
    {"check":{"eq":["$rules","$instructions"]},"label":"served instructions match the supplied text"},
    {"tool":"reset_account","save":"initial"},
    {"tool":"reset_account","args":{"address":"$inputs.recipient"},"save":"recipientInitial"},
    {"check":{"all":[{"gte":["$initial.balance","13"]},{"eq":["$initial.exits.length",0]}]},"label":"funded fresh local test player"},
    {"wait":{"label":"coherent lock preparation and trusted state","reads":[{"tool":"reset_prepare_move","args":{"t":"lock","p":{"amount":"10"}},"save":"packet"},{"check":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.envelope.t","lock"]},{"eq":["$packet.envelope.p.amount","10"]}]},"label":"review requested move before signing"},{"http":{"base":"$inputs.gatewayUrl","path":"/v1/state"},"save":"trustedState"}],"until":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.envelope.b","$trustedState.tip.height"]},{"eq":["$packet.envelope.h","$trustedState.tip.hash"]}]},"pollMs":100,"timeoutMs":10000}},
    {"local":{"command":"sign_and_solve","input":"$packet","flags":{"state":"$trustedState"}},"save":"signed"},
    {"tool":"reset_submit_move","args":"$signed","save":"submission"},
    {"check":{"eq":["$submission.ok",true]},"label":"lock accepted"},
    {"wait":{"label":"lock applied","reads":[{"tool":"reset_account","save":"current"}],"until":{"eq":["$current.deposit",{"add":["$initial.deposit","10"]}]},"pollMs":3000,"timeoutMs":240000}},
    {"wait":{"label":"coherent unlock preparation and trusted state","reads":[{"tool":"reset_prepare_move","args":{"t":"unlock","p":{"amount":"10"}},"save":"packet"},{"check":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.envelope.t","unlock"]},{"eq":["$packet.envelope.p.amount","10"]}]},"label":"review requested move before signing"},{"http":{"base":"$inputs.gatewayUrl","path":"/v1/state"},"save":"trustedState"}],"until":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.envelope.b","$trustedState.tip.height"]},{"eq":["$packet.envelope.h","$trustedState.tip.hash"]}]},"pollMs":100,"timeoutMs":10000}},
    {"local":{"command":"sign_and_solve","input":"$packet","flags":{"state":"$trustedState"}},"save":"signed"},
    {"tool":"reset_submit_move","args":"$signed","save":"submission"},
    {"check":{"eq":["$submission.ok",true]},"label":"unlock accepted"},
    {"wait":{"label":"unlock applied","reads":[{"tool":"reset_account","save":"current"}],"until":{"some":{"in":"$current.exits","where":{"eq":["$item.amount","10"]}}},"pollMs":3000,"timeoutMs":240000}},
    {"wait":{"label":"exits mature at counted height","reads":[{"tool":"reset_account","save":"current"},{"tool":"reset_state","save":"state"}],"until":{"every":{"in":"$current.exits","where":{"gte":["$state.counted","$item.release"]}}},"pollMs":3000,"timeoutMs":240000}},
    {"wait":{"label":"coherent withdraw preparation and trusted state","reads":[{"tool":"reset_prepare_move","args":{"t":"withdraw","p":{}},"save":"packet"},{"check":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.envelope.t","withdraw"]}]},"label":"review requested move before signing"},{"http":{"base":"$inputs.gatewayUrl","path":"/v1/state"},"save":"trustedState"}],"until":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.envelope.b","$trustedState.tip.height"]},{"eq":["$packet.envelope.h","$trustedState.tip.hash"]}]},"pollMs":100,"timeoutMs":10000}},
    {"local":{"command":"sign_and_solve","input":"$packet","flags":{"state":"$trustedState"}},"save":"signed"},
    {"tool":"reset_submit_move","args":"$signed","save":"submission"},
    {"check":{"eq":["$submission.ok",true]},"label":"withdraw accepted"},
    {"wait":{"label":"withdraw applied","reads":[{"tool":"reset_account","save":"current"}],"until":{"all":[{"eq":["$current.balance","$initial.balance"]},{"eq":["$current.exits.length",0]},{"eq":["$current.deposit","$initial.deposit"]}]},"pollMs":3000,"timeoutMs":240000}},
    {"tool":"reset_prepare_transfer","args":{"to":"$inputs.recipient","amount":"3"},"save":"packet"},
    {"check":{"all":[{"eq":["$packet.to","$inputs.recipient"]},{"eq":["$packet.amount","3"]},{"eq":["$packet.address","$identity.address"]}]},"label":"review recipient, amount and sender before signing"},
    {"local":{"command":"sign_transfer","input":"$packet","flags":{"context":"$inputs.contextFile"}},"save":"signed"},
    {"tool":"reset_submit_transfer","args":"$signed","save":"submission"},
    {"check":{"eq":["$submission.ok",true]},"label":"transfer submitted"},
    {"wait":{"label":"transfer settled","reads":[{"tool":"reset_account","save":"current"},{"tool":"reset_account","args":{"address":"$inputs.recipient"},"save":"recipientCurrent"}],"until":{"all":[{"eq":["$current.balance",{"subtract":["$initial.balance","3"]}]},{"eq":["$recipientCurrent.balance",{"add":["$recipientInitial.balance","3"]}]}]},"pollMs":3000,"timeoutMs":240000}}
  ],
  "result": {"address":"$identity.address","balance":"$current.balance","recipientBalance":"$recipientCurrent.balance"}
}
END CLIENT PLAN
